title: Not even worth $30. Caution at end of review.
text:
I got a box today that contained a $2 hawkeye pin, $5 captain marvel socks (seriously?), A $5 tiny viynl figure of Tyrion Lannister (3 inches tall, not pop vinyl brand) and a $10 canvas print of iron Man that's about 8 inches tall x 6 inches wide. That's not $100 worth of stuff it's $22, let's be generous and call it $30.

Also I asked for my order to be cancelled. I was sent a reply saying it was and I wouldn't be charged... Well it was never canceled, I was charged and when I checked my subscriptions it was still active.

BUYER BEWARE!
label: negative
